bounds.family: observation: six by-eye patterns in K4 against 1,000 shuffles

observations.observation: (1) most of one letter in one width-7 column
(2) commonest letter's share in two adjacent width-7 columns
(5) shortest window holding all but one copy of a 6-copy letter
(6) most equal letters at a fixed step of 2 or 3

bounds.note: selected by eye, so post hoc; only an observation outside every shuffle would become an item

notes: (1) most of one letter in one width-7 column: K4 4, p 0.204; (2) commonest letter's share in two adjacent width-7 columns: K4 0.875, p 0.004; (3) repeated bigrams: K4 10, p 0.04; (4) repeated-bigram spacings divisible by 4: K4 5, p 0.021; (5) shortest window holding all but one copy of a 6-copy letter: K4 12, p 0.004; (6) most equal letters at a fixed step of 2 or 3: K4 3, p 0.198
